title: Cohomological boundedness of stratified dualizable condensed sheaves
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and put $B=p_Y^*\Lambda$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(B)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with ordinary relative derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $K\in D(B)$ admit a finite stratification of $Y$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset], on each of which its derived restriction is dualizable: there are an object $D$ and evaluation $D\otimes K\to B$ and coevaluation $B\to K\otimes D$ with the two contraction composites equal to the identities, using the usual associators and unitors [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Then there exist integers $a\le b$ such that $H^j(K)=0$ for $j<a$ and for $j>b$. In particular, $K$ has a cochain representative $C^\bullet$ with $C^j=0$ for every $j<a$. No Noetherian, finite-dimensional, or regularity hypothesis is imposed.
